test_GTestEnvVarTest_testEnvVarAffectsFl: test that environment variables like GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE affect the corresponding Google Test flags
test_GTestEnvVarTest_testXmlOutputFile: test that the XML_OUTPUT_FILE environment variable sets the Google Test output flag to xml format
test_GTestEnvVarTest_testXmlOutputFileOv: test that GTEST_OUTPUT environment variable overrides XML_OUTPUT_FILE for the output flag
run_SetEnvVar: run SetEnvVar to set or unset an environment variable in the test environment dictionary
run_GetFlag: run GetFlag to execute the gtest_env_var_test_ binary and return its output for a given flag
